up: Retrieve the distinct ChEMBL ID, compound name (preferred name), and canonical SMILES for all molecules that appear in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1147425. Only include molecules that have a canonical SMILES available. Order the results by ChEMBL ID, then compound name, then canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1147425' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
